voidsworn.d: Port and starboard guns hit 40% harder after moving 2+ hexes (others get 10%).

hegemony.d: Backing off one hex costs 1 movement instead of 2.

chorus.d: The first turn each round costs no movement.

ithar.d: After moving 2+ hexes, enemies get −18 to hit it (others need 3 hexes for −5).

deathless.d: Passes through rocks, wrecks and enemy ships at no extra cost.
